harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured and verified the OpenTelemetry routing gateway. node1 accepts mTLS OTLP/HTTP on HTTPS port 4318; payments traces route exclusively to node2 and inventory traces exclusively to node3. Missing or unsupported namespaces return HTTP 503 before any batch member is delivered. Retained JSON data, certificates, configuration, and services survived sequential reboots of all three nodes.
actions_performed: Installed checksum-verified otelcol-contrib 0.159.0 on all nodes.
Created separate ingress and collector-to-collector PKI trust domains with node-local private keys.
Placed ingress client credentials in /root/otel-client on node1 with restrictive permissions.
Configured synchronous routing without queues or retries to prevent duplicate delivery.
Verified valid mixed-batch routing, atomic invalid-batch rejection, mTLS enforcement, and exact trace counts.
Rebooted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: HTTPS OTLP/HTTP gateway and client credentials on node1
evidence.summary: Current node1 state shows an active, enabled collector listening on 10.100.139.10:4318, rejection without a client certificate, authenticated HTTPS success, valid credentials under /root/otel-client, and a validated gateway configuration.
The gateway completes verified TLS handshakes to both backends using its internal certificate; node2 and node3 return TLS certificate-required alerts to clients without certificates.

evidence.requirement: Exclusive routing, retained data, no cross-routing, and no duplicates
evidence.summary: A final post-reboot mixed request returned HTTP 200. Each destination contains exactly five expected route records, every expected marker occurs once, and all opposing-route markers occur zero times.

evidence.requirement: Reject missing or unsupported namespaces atomically
evidence.summary: Final unsupported and missing-namespace mixed batches both returned HTTP 503. Neither invalid markers nor otherwise-valid members were retained, and both destination hashes remained unchanged.

Healthy baseline boot ID 28ae5f98-80ff-424c-9f6f-523320557628; safe reboot acknowledged; new boot ID 77e69485-82e2-4461-94b1-fda6d07ac6e6; gateway and both routes recovered with exclusive post-reboot retention.

Healthy baseline boot ID dfeb3b70-bc1e-4ce9-90d0-9c9c853416e7; safe reboot acknowledged; new boot ID 0cef6514-e861-4fbe-a995-befd1856ea61; service recovered with byte-identical prior data and accepted one new payments trace.

Healthy baseline boot ID e8afb731-420c-4162-a989-583aca271335; safe reboot acknowledged; new boot ID 61256f3c-9cb1-4c48-a015-deef17ecfc43; service recovered with byte-identical prior data and accepted one new inventory trace.
